license_note: Upstream README declares MIT and links LICENSE; that file is absent at the pinned revision. Source/calibration/weights are fetched separately, not redistributed here.
local_adapter: Unchanged FOTS MLP, smoothing, shadow and MarkerMotion with hardware-specific source weights/background/grid. CPU/private import compatibility. DIGIT shares TACTO CAD contact physics; FOTS uses calibrated orthographic geometric overlap, not TACTO force shift. Legacy --sensor fots retains flat GelSight proxy. Per-geom trajectory history and additive multi-object marker composition are local; not FEM. No upstream edits. Material-point anchors use the rendered object surface including depth and pixel centres, and renew when that point leaves the gel or sensing window; no time/flow cap. Not a stick-slip constitutive model.
